in_arabic.name: سميرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من السمرة، يعني الفتاة الحسناء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سميرة مشتق من الجذر السري 'س-م-ر' الذي يحمل معاني متعلقة بالجمال والحسن، ورد في بعض المراجع اللغوية العربية أن السمرة تعني الفتاة الجميلة ذات البشرة السمراء، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية كدلالة على الجمال والرقة

in_urdu.name: سمیرا

data.cultural_impact: The name Sumira is rooted in traditional Islamic culture and has an inherent connection to the natural world. The word 'sumura' means 'moon' in Arabic and has been a source of inspiration and enchantment throughout Islamic history. The moon is considered a symbol of beauty, tranquility, and change, as it waxes and wanes throughout the lunar cycle. Sumira is the embodiment of these qualities and carries the affection and reverence for this celestial body within her name.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the moon represents several spiritual concepts. It symbolizes the manifestation of God's power and omnipresence in our universe. The cycles of the moon and the phases it undergo resemble the constant change and evolution that occurs within us as individuals and within humanity. The moon is also a reminder of the Divine Guidance and protection that illuminates our lives. Thus, the spiritual significance of the name Sumira lies in its association with the heavenly bodies, the infinite wisdom of God, and the natural progression of life.
